lines.text: I'm going to catch some Zs.

data.define: A casual way to say you will sleep.

example.text: I'm going to catch some Zs.

misuse.text: Don't tell your boss you'll 'catch some Zs'.
misuse.why: It sounds like napping on work time.

data.l1_hook: Il se fait tard et je suis fatigué, je vais "catch some Zs".
